label: Maternity leave benefit — ceiling per 30 days
appliesTo: The government insurance payment. It does not displace the employer's separate wage obligation over the statutorily paid portion of the leave, so the employer may owe the difference.
why: Read as the total the worker receives, when for many it is only one of two payments — and the gap between the ceiling and ordinary wage is the employer's, not nobody's.

history.source: Ministry of Employment and Labor notice effective 2026-09-18
history.note: ₩6,600,000 across a standard 90-day leave. Premature and multiple births carry their own period totals.
